just.label: Just intonation
just.description: Chords tuned to whole-number frequency ratios drawn from a tonality diamond, found by simulated annealing and then threaded together with Viterbi optimisation. These are successive passes at the same idea, newest first — each refines the tuning search and the orchestration over the one before it.

werckmeister.label: Werckmeister III
werckmeister.description: A well temperament from 1691, contemporary with Bach. Keys retain distinct character rather than sounding identical.

12tet.label: 12-tone equal temperament
12tet.description: The modern standard: the octave split into twelve identical steps. Every key is equally usable and no chord is perfectly in tune.

early.label: Early experiments
early.description: The first renders, made before the density control existed — they use the legacy max-shift setting and much slower tempos. Kept for reference; superseded by the just-intonation passes above.

albums.title: Late August 2026
albums.blurb: The current rendering — the one the daily post draws from. A short-repeats pass on a new tuning search that closes the gap in cents between adjacent chords to zero or near zero, at the cost of slightly higher integer-ratio scores.
